history.overview: The Discord Wastes are the oldest and most unstable Discord rupture in Kuua.

timeline.name: First Discord Ruptures
timeline.description: Discord energy tore open the land, creating unstable fissures.

timeline.name: Arcane Collapse
timeline.description: Entire sections of terrain collapsed into Discord void pockets.

timeline.name: Manifestation Era
timeline.description: Discord entities began appearing in large numbers.

timeline.name: Muramite Observation
timeline.description: Muramite forces established fortified outposts to monitor activity.

timeline.name: Current Era
timeline.description: The Wastes remain the most dangerous region in Kuua.
